definitions.explanation: A common, everyday grade of Japanese green tea made from larger, mature leaves harvested later in the season. Less refined than {煎茶|せんちゃ} but widely drunk as an everyday beverage. It has a mild, slightly astringent flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{番茶|ばんちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: To drink bancha after a meal.

examples.japanese: {番茶|ばんちゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手頃|てごろ}→手頃：04068_tegoro⟧で⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{飲|の}める→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: Bancha is affordable enough to drink every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{番茶|ばんちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やかん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沸|わ}かして→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}んでいた→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother always brewed a large pot of bancha in a kettle for the whole family to drink.

notes:
USAGE:
A staple everyday tea in Japan, less expensive and less delicate than ⟦{煎茶|せんちゃ}→煎茶：13407_sencha⟧ (sencha). Made from larger, coarser leaves picked in the later harvest. Often served at restaurants as a complimentary tea.

The proverb ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{十八|じゅうはち}→十八：00948_juuhachi⟧、{番茶|ばんちゃ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{出花|でばな} (even a demon at eighteen, even bancha at first brew) means that anything can look its best at the right moment — used humorously about young women.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {番茶|ばんちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to brew bancha
- {番茶|ばんちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かす→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧: to boil bancha
- {京番茶|きょうばんちゃ}: Kyoto-style roasted bancha
- {番茶|ばんちゃ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{出花|でばな}: bancha at its first brew (proverb)
